title: Mars Perseverance Sol 1042: Left Mastcam-Z Camera
caption:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its Left Mastcam-Z camera. Mastcam-Z is a pair of cameras located high on the rover's mast.

This image was acquired on Jan. 25, 2024 (Sol 1042) at the local mean solar time of 09:13:04.
